judged_text: The admin/owner authorization check joins the two role queries with && instead of ||, so only a user who is simultaneously team admin AND team owner passes, and plain team admins are denied despite the error message implying broader access. Team admins (non-owners) who should be able to manage guests on their team's bookings get a 403 FORBIDDEN, or conversely the intended permission matrix is silently narrower than designed; either way the authorization decision does not match the intended policy.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the authorization flag `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner to pass. This is a verifiable logic defect in the diff because the subsequent permission gate `if (!isTeamAdminOrOwner && !isOrganizer && !isAttendee) throw FORBIDDEN` will deny plain admins (non-owners), contradicting the variable name and the finding’s described intent.
